name: Rare Earth
tagline: Two hundred and seventy-nine plots across eighteen acres.
description: Rare Earth is a low-density plotted development on the Mysuru–Ooty road, at the tenth kilometre stone near Kadakola. Two hundred and seventy-nine plots sit across eighteen acres, 280 metres from NH 766 and about two kilometres from Mysore airport.
